en.headline: HK Electric worker suffers burns in North Point switchgear explosion
en.dek: A 28-year-old male employee was taken to Queen Mary Hospital with facial and hand burns after a transformer fault caused a fire at the Electric Centre; he remained conscious.
body: A 28-year-old male HK Electric employee surnamed Lai suffered burns to his face, hands and right side after an explosion in a switchgear room at the company’s Electric Centre in North Point on Wednesday afternoon.

Police received a report at about 5:17pm. Firefighters controlled the fire by 5:30pm using a water jet and breathing apparatus. The Fire Services Department said the blaze was sparked by a malfunctioning transformer and there was no evidence of criminal involvement.

HK Electric said it was alerted at about 5:08pm to an abnormality in low-voltage equipment. The company expressed concern for the staff member, who was conscious when taken to hospital, and is cooperating with the investigation. Power supply to customers remained normal, though some floors of the building were affected.

zh.headline: 北角電燈中心電摳房爆炸 28歲男職員燒傷送院
zh.dek: 一名28歲姓黎男職員在電燈中心因變壓器故障引致火警後，臉部及雙手燒傷，送玛麗醫院時仍清醒。
body: 周三下午，港燈一名28歲姓黎男職員在北角電燈中心電摳房發生爆炸，臉部、雙手及右邊身體燒傷。
警方約下午5時17分接報。消防員使用一條喉及呼吸器具，至5時30分將火救熄。消防處初步調查指火警由變壓器故障引致，暫無刑事成分。
港燈表示約下午5時08分接獲低壓設備異常報告，十分關注員工情況並提供支援，正配合調查。客戶電力供應維持正常，但電燈中心部分樓層供電受影響。
